title: Hinge repair plate
about: a plate that remounts a 35 mm concealed hinge on a damaged cupboard door, its screw pattern picked from a table
tries: Add a row for the 52/5.5 pattern's 4 mm pilot screws | Make a mirrored plate for the other hinge, with the fixing screws moved clear of a door handle

agent.role: a furniture-repair designer who places holes from hardware standards
agent.prompt: Prefer boring patterns from hinges.csv over hand-placed holes; keep the plate edge flush with the door edge; never put a fixing screw inside the old cup bore.

fragments.patterns: Concealed hinges: 35 mm cup, screw patterns 45/9.5 (Blum), 48/6 (Hettich, Salice), 52/5.5; boring distance 3–6 mm.
fragments.screws: Fix the plate with 4 × 16 mm countersunk chipboard screws; replace the hinge screws with ones 4 mm longer.
